LightningComponentBundle.description: Draws any object with a lookup to itself as a tree. Names link to their records, any branch can be zoomed into, and a breadcrumb leads back out. Starts on built-in sample data; set Data source to Records to show real records.

property.name: iconName
property.label: Icon
property.description: An SLDS icon name, for example standard:hierarchy.

property.name: layout
property.label: Layout
property.description: Tree: names only. Columns: the column fields line up beside each name, like a related list. Org chart: cards for a small hierarchy, three levels at a time. Columns and Org chart fall back to narrow forms in a narrow space.

property.name: hierarchySource
property.label: Data source
property.description: Sample shows a built-in tree with no setup. Records reads the object named below.

property.name: hierarchyObjectApiName
property.label: Object API name
property.description: The object to draw. It needs a lookup to itself.

property.name: parentFieldApiName
property.label: Parent field API name
property.description: The object's lookup to itself.

property.name: typeFieldApiName
property.label: Type field API name
property.description: Optional. Shown as a badge on each row; a picklist shows its label.

property.name: activeFieldApiName
property.label: Active field API name
property.description: Optional. A checkbox; rows where it is false are muted.

property.name: columnFieldApiNames
property.label: Column fields
property.description: Optional. Up to five comma-separated field API names for the Columns layout and the org-chart cards. A lookup shows the related name; Relationship.Field reads one field through one lookup, for example Owner.Alias.

property.name: avatarFieldApiName
property.label: Avatar field API name
property.description: Optional. A short text field, such as a code, for the org-chart avatars. A code like REG-EUR shows EUR; blank shows initials.

property.name: hideInactive
property.label: Hide inactive records
property.description: Hides inactive records and everything below them.

property.name: rootRecordId
property.label: Top record Id
property.description: Optional. The view starts zoomed in on this record.

property.name: isRootLocked
property.label: Lock to the top record
property.description: Viewers cannot go above the top record. A view setting, not security: sharing decides what users can see.

property.name: shouldStartAtRecord
property.label: Start at the current record
property.description: On a record page, start zoomed in on the record being viewed.

property.name: hideBranchColors
property.label: Hide branch colors
property.description: Turns off the colored stripe that marks which branch each row belongs to.
